decisions.reason: The retail system interface plugin reflects the firm's claimed core competence in interface development and supports its full-service integration offer, so we can still treat modest uptake as a normal ramp-up rather than failure.
The relaunch SEO service has its own page, is central to the firm's shop-relaunch and marketing positioning, and runs on existing specialists at low marginal cost.

The SEO workshops were launched only in 2024 and are presented on their own page, which makes them a fresh, visible commitment that fits the firm's marketing expertise, so it is too early to judge them a failure.
